description: Run a read-only GraphQL QUERY against Toast's online-ordering gateway (ws-api.toasttab.com/do-federated-gateway) through your signed-in browser, and return its raw data and errors. For exploring fields the dedicated tools don't cover yet. Mutations and subscriptions are refused. Known-good operations: nearbyRestaurants(input:{diningOption,fulfillmentDateTime,latitude,longitude,radius}) and menusV3(input:{restaurantGuid,visibility}). Validation errors name the fields the schema lacks — use them to correct the query rather than guessing repeatedly.

operation_name.description: Which operation to run, if the document has several.

variables.description: Variables object, if the document declares any.

name: toast_graphql
